capabilities: Create time blocks by dragging on the Day and Week timeline
Add tasks inside time blocks in daily notes
Schedule backlog items with resurface dates
Offer repeating blocks and tasks from Routines each day
Group work into projects and domains and view activity on a timeline
extras: Listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile touch is tested on Android only; iOS and iPadOS are untested. Full documentation lives in external Getting started, Guide, and Reference pages.
problem: Obsidian task tools leave tasks floating in backlogs without forcing you to decide when and where the work actually happens.

relations.evidence: Make sure daily notes are set up (Settings → Daily notes, or the Periodic Notes plugin)

summary: Time-blocking planner that stores each day as markdown time blocks containing tasks, with Day, Week, Grid, Backlog, Routines, and Timeline views.
